verdict.rationale: Lever's 'Talent Fit' feature claims AI-powered matching against roles using customizable criteria (lever-docs-21), satisfying the basic screening/matching capability, but there is no documentation describing how the matching algorithm works, what data it uses, or what safeguards (bias testing, human review requirements, compliance disclosures) apply to automated candidate decisions. Missing for 10: technical/methodology documentation of the matching model, explicit safeguards or bias-mitigation disclosures, and any compliance/audit information for automated hiring decisions.
